messages:
customer_acme: Hey team — noticed ~2% of our calls to /v1/generate with json_mode=true started returning PARSE_FAILED errors in the last 3 hours, and billing shows a small token spike. Example error from client: "PARSE_FAILED: invalid JSON, unexpected end of input". We send streaming responses and sometimes get truncated JSON. Can you help?

ella_support: Sorry for the trouble — can you paste a redacted request+response example? Don't include raw PII or full API key. If you can provide the trace id from the response headers that's ideal (x-rw-trace-id).

customer_acme: Pasted redacted snippet: ```request: POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json
body: {"prompt":"summarize...","json_mode":true,"max_tokens":150}
```
response (client side): ```{"summary":"Top-line...","items":[{"id":1,"text":"ok"}, {"id":2,"text":"partial"
"error":"PARSE_FAILED: invalid JSON, unexpected end of input"}```
No x-rw-trace-id in response headers. Billing dashboard shows a small uptick at same minute.

sam_oncall: Thanks. Two quick suspects: 1) streaming truncated by an intermediate proxy closing connection mid-stream (produces incomplete JSON) 2) auth rotation hitting a 401 that causes the stream to cut — both can appear as parse failures and still be billed for tokens already emitted. Do you have client-side network logs (connection reset / 401 mid-stream)?

customer_acme: We do see occasional socket reset (ECONNRESET) in the client around the same time. No 401s seen on client.

riley_eng_ml: Two engineering notes: when streaming structured output we rely on the server finishing the final JSON chunk with the closing brackets. If the connection is cut before the final chunk, the client sees invalid JSON. From infra we can check server-side send completion traces. Can you confirm you are using token streaming (server-sent events) vs chunked HTTP?

customer_acme: We're using chunked streaming (Fetch in browser).

ella_support: OK — that helps. Infra, can you pull traces for window around 2024-11-01T14:07:12Z (thread_ts 1742978432) for connections from customer_acme's IP range? Also check if any auth rekey / rotate job ran at that minute.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed at 2024-11-01T14:05:00Z on cluster eu-west-1; no auth rotation jobs logged at 14:06-14:09.

riley_eng_ml: I pulled the send logs for the user's request id (matched by connection 10.2.*). Server emitted final chunk but the client TCP teardown occurred ~150ms before flush confirmation from edge -> origin. Edge shows RST from client. So server thinks it delivered, but edge lost it. That explains parse failure on client.

tess_product: That fits the billing spike question — if the model emitted tokens before the connection closed, our billing counted tokens issued by the model. We should make sure our docs explain that partial-output billing can occur for truncated streams. But we also should provide a better observability signal to identify these cases automatically.

ella_support: Actionable customer steps first: 1) If possible, switch to SSE or the SDK's built-in streaming helper which handles reconnect+resume for short blips. 2) Add client retry for transient connection closes (idempotent for your use case) or request non-streaming (complete response) for high-value calls.

riley_eng_ml: Engineering action items for us: 1) Add a metric json.stream.incomplete (counter) emitted when client disconnect detected before final send ack. 2) Add trace tag "stream_disconnect_reason" (RST/FIN/timeout) and surface in Console traces. 3) Add a diagnostic header in final chunk: `X-Redwood-Stream-Finished: 1` so clients can assert receipt. 4) Investigate a billing safety-net: if parse fails at client and trace shows client-initiated RST within 1s of final chunk, flag for review and surface to billing team.

ella_support: For immediate troubleshooting, please ask the customer to enable debug headers (we can instruct them to set `X-RW-Debug: true` in request — this will cause us to include `x-rw-trace-id` in the response and extra delivery debug in our logs).

customer_acme: I'll enable debug headers and repro. Also curious — any risk we leaked anything in logs? We redact PII but we want confirmation.

riley_eng_ml: We redact request bodies in the access logs by default. The streaming pipeline currently logs meta events (start/finish/flush) with trace_id, but we only persist the final chunk size/finish flag, not full payload. We'll confirm redaction status in the specific traces.

ella_support: Next steps summary for customer: 1) Enable X-RW-Debug and re-run a failing request 2) Capture client network logs (socket reset timestamps) 3) Switch to SDK streaming helper if possible and share repro detail. We'll follow up once you provide the debug trace id.

customer_acme: Reproduced with debug header. New response headers included: `x-rw-trace-id: rw-20241101-9a3f` and we saw ECONNRESET at client 14:07:18. Sending that trace id now.

ella_support: Got it — attaching to eng.

riley_eng_ml: Found trace rw-20241101-9a3f. Edge shows final chunk acknowledged by origin but connection RST from client at ~14:07:18. Confirmed `json.stream.incomplete` emitted once for this trace. Also found parse.failure metric increment at that minute.

ella_support: Thanks all. Main outcomes: cause = client-side RST leading to truncated JSON; billing counted emitted tokens; customer to adopt SDK helper or non-streaming for critical calls; engineering to add better metrics and final-chunk header to help clients assert completeness.

tess_product: I'll add a Console note in the Structured Output docs about partial-stream billing and how to identify them in the dashboard (new filter: `json.stream.incomplete:true`). Also we'll add an inline FAQ about client-side reconnect patterns.

ella_support: Follow-ups: (A) Riley to open ticket to add metric + header + trace tag (B) Billing to evaluate safety-net policy for customer spikes (C) Support to update docs + send customer mitigation steps.

riley_eng_ml: Will open ENG-PLAT-592 (metric+header) and include perf acceptance tests.

ella_support: Closing loop with customer once the docs & infra changes are in place. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
